**Task 2: Essay on the Observer Pattern and B-Trees**

**Introduction**  
Software engineering relies on design patterns and data structures to build scalable, maintainable, and efficient systems. Two foundational concepts—the observer pattern and B-trees—serve distinct yet critical roles. The observer pattern decouples components by establishing a one-to-many dependency, enabling automatic notification of state changes. B-trees, on the other hand, are self-balancing tree structures optimized for storage systems, providing logarithmic performance for search, insertion, and deletion
